<div class="home-manifesto">
<p class="home-manifesto-proverb">"You cross to my side, and I cross to yours, so that we may meet. Who am I?"</p>
<p class="home-manifesto-attribution">Kuba proverb</p>
<img class="home-manifesto-divider" src="/odeka_logo_diamond.png" alt="">
<p class="home-manifesto-mission">Good intentions are not enough. We use history, culture, institutions, and insights across disciplines to understand what might work, and rigorous experiments to learn what does, what does not, for whom, and in which context.</p>
</div>

<div class="home-quote-row">
<div class="home-quote-row-image">

<div class="home-quote">
<img src="/odeka_logo_diamond.png" alt="">
<blockquote><img class="quote-bracket left" src="/odeka_logo_left_bracket.png" alt="">Intentionally or not, the forms of economic, industrial, and political organization that were central to each success story were drawn from the local context, or by melding lessons from economics and political science with characteristics of local culture and society.<img class="quote-bracket right" src="/odeka_logo_right_bracket.png" alt=""></blockquote>
<cite>Jacob Moscona, Nathan Nunn &amp; James A. Robinson<span>"Searching for Fish in Trees (缘木求鱼)? Economic Development When Context Matters," Working Paper, 2026</span></cite>
</div>
</div>
